key_insight: MedUIGym provides a testbed for clinical GUI agents, showing that current models struggle with EHR workflows but can improve through task-specific training.
clinical_relevance: The platform supports research on agents that navigate EHR screens and execute workflow actions, rather than only generate text.
method: Agents use screenshots and mouse-and-keyboard actions, with a paired native-tool interface over identical clinical data.
Evaluation checks both final answers and required clinical actions.
GUI trajectories and task rewards support offline learning and online reinforcement learning.
evidence_signal: Across 15,739 tasks from 17 benchmark sources and six clinical task families, evaluation of 12 vision-language models found workflow difficulties; training improved both Qwen3.5 models on in-domain and external-source tasks.
watch_item: Benchmark improvements do not establish safety or reliability in live clinical EHR workflows.
paper_title: MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows
